Chapter 932: Chapter 1 Beyond the Universe (Please Subscribe)

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

In a daze,

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“Back again.”

Lin Yuan looked around and let out a light sigh.

Since returning from the mega battlefield, Lin Yuan’s true self had entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Because this place could be considered absolutely safe, even those of the twelfth Layer Path Splitting Realm would not be able to find it.

As for the Dominator Realm, the Chaos Realm?

Unless rulers of the Main Universe from the Dominator Realm or Chaos Realm, or surviving twelfth Layers from other realms, were rejected by the universe, they wouldn’t even be able to enter, let alone locate the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

And to breakthrough to the Dominator Realm within a single Cosmic Era… is as hard as ascending to the heavens, who knows how many Cosmic Eras are needed to birth just one such being.

Moreover, ordinary beings of the Dominator Realm cannot locate the coordinates of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Xuanhuang, as a peak force in the Chaos Realm, dared to set the heritage site of Profound Xuanhuang within the universe, surely deeming it to be perfectly safe.

With the protection of the universe, even if the Xuanhuang truly falls, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm can exist for a very, very long time.

…

Lin Yuan’s true self hid within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

It was naturally to guard against the ultimate twelve Layers of other peak clan powers.

After all, Lin Yuan’s performance on the mega battlefield was too outstanding.

One could say he singlehandedly swept through the forces of the other peak clans.

Those ultimate twelve Layers from the eleven great peak clans might put aside their pride to secretly assassinate him.

Of course, the strongest of human civilization were definitely guarding against this possibility as well.

But regardless, Lin Yuan still felt the safest within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“Hmm?”

“Time and space can actually be utilized like this?”

“Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful!”

Lin Yuan’s gaze turned towards the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Following the Seventh Realm of time and space, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm appeared differently in Lin Yuan’s eyes all of a sudden.

The time-space mysteries involved, even Lin Yuan at the moment could only discern a fraction of them.

The energy contained in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm wasn’t vast, but its profundity was definitely at the Chaos Realm level.

“Chaos?”

The more Lin Yuan looked, the deeper he delved, faintly discovering a trace of chaotic power at the very core of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Humming sounds!

Within Lin Yuan’s eyes, myriad rules turned. The Chaos Rule coursed through his body, the Chaos Rule bred within the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan also mastered it the instant he returned to the Main Universe.

Boom— The entire Xuanhuang Secret Realm began to vibrate slightly, Lin Yuan attracted that trace of chaotic power from the deepest part of the realm, faintly seeing a vision of an extremely ancient past.

In the vast Chaos Void, there stood a towering figure dressed in a golden dragon robe, with fluttering black hair. He raised his right hand, sending thirty-three thousand, three hundred and thirty-three strands of chaotic power into the immense void, integrating them into thirty-three thousand, three hundred and thirty-three universes, forming the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“Is that the Xuanhuang?”

Startled in his heart, Lin Yuan had never seen the Xuanhuang, but he was convinced that this towering figure was the Xuanhuang.

“So this is how the Xuanhuang Secret Realm came to be? The Xuanhuang did not create it one by one, but opened it up all at once?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

When cultivating the “Illusory Reality” secret technique, he had seen the legacy image left by the Moyu Tower Master, but compared to the present Xuanhuang, seemed to be on a lower level.

Of course, it’s also possible that the image left by the Moyu Tower Master was simply too trivial.

“Thirty-three thousand, three hundred and thirty-three Xuanhuang Secret Realms?” Lin Yuan realized that, by using the Chaos Rule, he briefly connected to the Chaotic Origin of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which is why he was able to see these visions.

“I should now fully control this secret realm, right?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

After all, he was not the creator of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and even as its new master, his control over the realm was still lacking that little bit.

But now, after communicating with the Chaotic Origin of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan could be said to have completely taken hold of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, even if the Xuanhuang returned, he could no longer contest with him for control over the realm.

…

“What, what happened?”

At a high point in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, a six-armed figure looked at the changes in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm with shock.

As the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the six-armed figure naturally had complete control over every detail of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

At this moment, the vibration of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and the traction of its Chaotic Origin were likewise perceived by him.

“The Chaotic Origin of the secret realm…”

The six-armed figure could hardly believe it; the Chaotic Origin was the foundation of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, as well as the power left behind by the Xuanhuang originally.

Although it had been assimilated by the universe after merging, severing it from Xuanhuang’s ownership, the level of power was clear.

To attract the secret realm’s Chaotic Origin, one must first comprehend the Chaos Rule, which the vast majority of those at the pinnacle of the Dominator Realm cannot achieve.

“Chaos Rule? Has the master comprehended the Chaos Rule?”

The six-armed figure’s mind was muddled, merely grasping the Chaos Rule wasn’t enough to attract the secret realm’s Chaotic Origin, one must be the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to accomplish this.

That is to say, the current changes in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm stemmed from Lin Yuan, who had already realized the Chaos Rule.

“The master… hasn’t stepped into the twelfth Layer yet, right?” the six-armed figure contemplated with difficulty.

Without reaching the twelfth Layer?

Comprehending the Chaos Rule?

Even at Xuanhuang’s level of realm, such an exceptional genius had never been seen before, only heard of in ancient records, with no certainty whether such a being has ever existed.

And now,

This exceptional genius had actually appeared before him, a mere Spirit of the Secret Realm?

…

“Master…”

Not far from Lin Yuan, the six-armed figure appeared, looking towards the young man sitting cross-legged in front of him, with Chaos Aura circulating around his body, and called out with a touch of awe.

“Hmm…”

Lin Yuan looked towards the six-armed figure.
